design.authority: User instruction: tests 1 and 2, original ghost measure and Yen specifications. Source: saved Lourie validation protocol, original Table 3, original classifications and financial links.
tests: Same baseline plus original review ghost score and postings x ghost interaction
design.main_sample: Original linked firms, USD statements, December fiscal ends so the unchanged original calendar-year ghost measure ends at fiscal t. At least five original reviews in t. Fiscal t >= 2016 and consecutive financial t-1,t,t+1. Both first-quarter posting windows must be fully covered. Last outcome is constrained by original financial data (2024). Baseline and interaction share observations within outcome/specification.
design.postings: Deduplicate globally by job_id. Count days active using post_date <= day < remove_date; missing remove_date right-censored at observation end 2026-10-10. Average active postings during first three calendar months of fiscal t+1 minus same months of fiscal t, divided by AT_t. Sign ranks: two equal-count negative groups, zero group, two equal-count positive groups, scores 0,.25,.5,.75,1; ties retain rank. Rank sample fixed before outcome/control completeness.
design.ghost: Primary: unchanged saved p_it_ebayes in year t (original weights, threshold and offer overrides). This legacy smoother uses a full-history firm prior. Raw original p_it is a prespecified timing-safe sensitivity, with same labels. No new LLM classification.
design.effects: Two-digit SIC industry and fiscal-year effects; firm-clustered standard errors. Firm/year effects reported as sensitivity.
design.missing_data: No zero imputation of missing expenses or missing ghost years. A zero posting count is observed only after complete source scan and coverage check.
design.winsorization: Continuous financial changes, book-to-market and asset-scaled posting change clipped at pooled 1st/99th percentiles before regression; bounds saved. Original financial series are reconstructed from source rather than re-winsorizing a previously clipped panel.
specifications: Full Lourie controls; saved original ghost score (main)
Core controls excluding R&D and advertising
Full controls with raw original ghost share
Core controls with raw original ghost share
design.inference: Report every planned outcome and fit, 95% intervals and both ordinary and Holm-adjusted p-values across the four outcome tests separately for baseline posting and ghost-interaction families. Sensitivity findings are not selected for publication based on significance.
design.limits: Indeed source is a different platform/sample than original career-site data, so this reproduces the design in a new dataset, not original numerical estimates. Current parent rollups may differ from historical ownership. Posting disappearance does not establish hiring. No posting-to-hire measure until independent position starts arrive.
design.inference_implementation: Company-clustered covariance with finite-cluster correction; two-sided t tests and 95% intervals use number of companies minus one degrees of freedom. This implementation was fixed before estimating any posting regressions and independently checked with dummy-variable OLS.

coverage_amendment.timing: Before any regressions estimated, after a 64-file raw posting-date coverage diagnostic
coverage_amendment.evidence: Sampled 2017 February/March counts 3453/2099 versus 17888 in January. December 2020/January 2021 counts 130/136; February 2021 2687 versus March 2021 51557. Early 2016 ramp also present. These are source-wide recording anomalies, not firm-outcome-selected exclusions.
coverage_amendment.amendment: Retain original full 2016-2023 benchmark and all originally planned sensitivities. Add coverage_full and coverage_core specifications restricted to t>=2018 and excluding t=2020,2021 because either Q1_t or Q1_t+1 then includes the thin Q1 2021. Report alongside the full window; do not treat the retained subset as provider-certified complete coverage. Rank cutoffs remain frozen from the original predictor sample.

deduplication.rule: One job_id counted once; earliest opening and latest removal, with missing removal censored at 2026-10-11. Exclude job_ids mapped to multiple issuers and negative lifetimes. Same-day removals contribute zero days under the declared half-open interval [post_date,remove_date), so do not enter the daily-active stock. Dates after March 2024 are not required for the original financial outcome panel.

interpretation: The actual-posting tests are inconclusive. With full Lourie controls, 340 company-years from 68 firms do not show a statistically clear positive posting-to-growth relationship for employees, SG&A, revenue or operating earnings. None of the ghost-score interactions is significant, including before four-outcome adjustment. Core controls increase coverage to 864-865 company-years from 175 firms; raw ghost shares, company effects and the recording-coverage subset also do not establish the expected pattern. This does not establish that the review measure is wrong: the baseline recruitment-to-operations link needed for this check is itself unclear in the matched sample. The separate-review 5.6% versus 3.6% finding is unchanged. The standalone baseline, which does not require scored reviews, is also inconclusive: full controls give 455 company-years from 74 firms; core controls give 1,222-1,223 company-years from 185 firms. Eight standalone fits complete the broader baseline scope after the 64 paired fits; all are reported.

standalone_baseline_scope_completion.timing: After the 64 paired fits were observed and verified, before these eight standalone baseline fits.
standalone_baseline_scope_completion.reason: Scope completion: Yen requested the posting replication for as many firms as available. A standalone posting baseline does not require observed ghost scores. Retain all paired common-sample results unchanged and additionally show the baseline on all original financially linked firms/years with posting coverage, without conditioning on review availability. This does not rescue or replace an inconclusive matched interaction.
standalone_baseline_scope_completion.sample: Original unambiguous financial firms; USD; December fiscal end; fiscal t=2016-2023; consecutive financial records; positive assets; observed posting windows. No minimum review count and no ghost availability condition.
standalone_baseline_scope_completion.controls: Both full Lourie controls and core controls excluding R&D and advertising; original no-imputation rules.
standalone_baseline_scope_completion.ranking: Separate sign-rank cutoffs use the broader eligible predictor sample before control/outcome completeness.
standalone_baseline_scope_completion.reporting: All four outcomes for both control sets, regardless of sign or significance. Baseline only; no ghost effect can be estimated in unscored years.
